Chennai road collapses, trapping a car in a sinkhole

A sinkhole measuring approximately 10 feet deep opened up on the Old Mahabalipuram Road (OMR) in Chennai, causing a car to fall into it. The occupants of the vehicle managed to escape the incident unharmed. The road collapsed, leading to the formation of the sinkhole.
